Lopunny

Normal

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Lopunny is a Normal-type Rabbit Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 33.3 kg. It evolves from Buneary. Its highest base stat is Speed (105), with a base stat total of 480.
